summary: Fail closed for list-folder writes that acknowledge HTTP success without read-back persistence.
reason: A disposable marker probe sent the existing typed save-list-folder operation to /data/list-folders/update and received HTTP 200, but a fresh user-data read omitted the folder. The cleanup remove-list-folder operation also returned HTTP 200 and the marker remained absent. Until folder create/rename/delete round-trips are verified, folder create and delete must not perform live mutations or report success; dry-run previews and folder listing remain available.
validated_outcome: Non-dry-run folder create/delete now return explicit unsupported read-after-write-verification errors before any request. Focused tests cover both fail-closed paths and preserve offline dry-run behavior. The disposable marker folder was absent on fresh read-back after the acknowledged create and after cleanup; no production folder data was changed. List settings is explicitly read-only; no sharing/invite write command exists in this CLI.
